title: Degree filtration from chosen algebra and module elements
statement: Let $A$ and $B$ be commutative rings, and let $M$ be an abelian group with $A$-module and $B$-module structures. Let $n,r\geq0$ and choose finite families $b_i\in B$ ($i\in\operatorname{Fin}(n)$) and $m_j\in M$ ($j\in\operatorname{Fin}(r)$). For each $d\geq0$ define the generator degree submodule by $F_d(b,m)=\operatorname{span}_A\{(\prod_i b_i^{\alpha_i})m_j:\alpha\in\mathbf N^n,\ \sum_i\alpha_i\leq d,\ j\in\operatorname{Fin}(r)\}$, using the submodule span [def-weil-submodule-span]. This is the defining formula, whether or not the chosen families generate; in an $A$-algebra $B$ acting compatibly on $M$, with generating families, it is the generator filtration used in homogenization.
